risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and explains reported versus adjusted performance, but emphasizes non-GAAP measures that exclude substantial derivative fair-value volatility. Adjusted TIER remains only modestly above the 1.10 minimum and adjusted debt-to-equity increased to 6.18, exceeding the stated approximately 6.00 target. Overall tone is cautiously positive, supported by improved earnings and equity, but leverage, margin compression, interest-rate exposure, and assumption-sensitive loan-loss benefits remain material risks.
